I replied to Tobias in his thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from this incident channel, which he's a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch's totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day she said it was resolved and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

Nothing he can see gives a street address or more detail about the site, so I suggested he ask Priyanka. I didn't check the gbrain knowledge brain, because the channel already answered the question.
